notes: LAUNCH-CRITICAL CHECK CONFIRMED (Scenario 12): this is the first under-25-employee scenario in the run, testing the raised qualification threshold for very small companies (hold=60, accept=80, vs. the standard hold=45, accept=65 used in all prior scenarios). The underlying diagnostic fit score of 57 would have cleared the standard 45-point HOLD bar (as seen ACCEPTing scores as low as 45 in Scenario 20), but under the raised 60-point bar for under-25 companies it correctly falls short and the result is REJECT with no CTA. This confirms the company-size-based threshold adjustment is functioning as designed — smaller companies face a higher bar before triggering a sales conversation, likely reflecting lower deal-size economics. Scores match manifest exactly (Readiness 38%, Workflow Opportunity 50%). Ran solo, single tab, fresh /questions navigation.
